historical_pattern.summary: MST-wi: unused query parameters must not grant a privileged body the clean URL did not have.

entrypoints: HTTP object GET with extra query noise

invariant: Adding role=admin or similar query noise must not introduce a secret absent from the baseline response.

oracle.success_means: query noise granted a secret the baseline response did not contain

severity_rationale: Hidden debug/role query flags are a common incomplete-fix leftover.
